entities.summary: Sacha Feinberg-Mngomezulu is a South African professional rugby union player who plays for Western Province in the Currie Cup, the Stormers in the United Rugby Championship (URC), and the South Africa national team. He currently holds the record for the most points scored in a game by a South African player with 37.
